metadata.title: Implement External API Client
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Implement a complete external API client including contracts, settings, interface, and implementation. Use when integrating with external HTTP APIs.

output.description: Complete API client with contracts, settings, interface, implementation

specificActions: Study Existing Patterns: Search for similar API clients, authentication patterns, HTTP client wrapper usage
Create/Locate Contracts: Check if contracts already exist; create request/response DTOs if needed
Create Settings Class: Create settings with configuration properties; register in configuration binding
Create Client Interface: Define interface with async methods and CancellationToken support
Implement Client Class: Implement using HTTP client wrapper; add authentication handling; add error handling and logging
Register in DI Container: Add client registration; configure HTTP client settings
tools: read_file - Read existing API client patterns
bestPractices: Search for similar contract models in ExternalServices/*/Contracts/
Search for similar API integrations in ExternalServices/
Include async methods with CancellationToken support
